Description
: Discover an intriguing assortment of rocks, minerals, and shells housed in a handy compartmentalized plastic case. This set includes vibrant mineral clusters, raw geode pieces, and polished as well as natural shells. Notable is a shell decorated with a Sagittarius motif, adding a unique astrological touch to the collection. The selection showcases various colors, textures, and forms, making it ideal for enthusiasts, educational purposes, or display. The case itself is sturdy and features secure yellow clasps, ensuring safe storage and portability. Each specimen is distinct, providing a firsthand look at nature's variety and beauty. The set appears to be in used, clean condition with all pieces intact as shown in the images. Case measures approximately 13 inches in length. Perfect for beginner collectors, students, or as a gift for anyone interested in geology and natural history. Please review all photographs to see the exact items included and current condition
